**Other information:**

The Portal boots `neo-theme-neo-dark` (`themes[0]`), but `viewport.theme` stays null until the first switch. `onSwitchTheme` fell back to a hardcoded light theme, so the first click "switched" to the dark theme that was already showing.

- `onSwitchTheme` now reads `viewport.getTheme()`, which falls back to the boot theme, so one click goes dark to light and a second goes back (AC-1).
- The icon logic moved out of `setTheme()` into `updateThemeSwitchIcon()`. `onConstructed` calls it when there's no stored theme and no dark preference, so a dark boot shows the sun instead of the static moon (AC-2). The OS-preference path is unchanged.

Tests: added specs to `ViewportController.spec.mjs` for a fresh dark boot, a fresh light boot, and the icon mapping. All 10 tests in the file pass, and the dark-boot spec fails without the fix.

Per CONTRIBUTING §5: made with Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code). I reviewed the change and tests.

Thanks @abhinav-rb. Your unit specs cover the method; I also checked the page itself in a browser.

One fresh headless Chromium context per row, `apps/portal` served from the tree under test, reading the body's theme class, the viewport background and the button icon at boot and after two clicks:

| stored `portalTheme` | color scheme | `dev` @ `c6b71bf39b` | this PR @ `299d1e0244` |
|---|---|---|---|
| none | light | moon on a dark page; click 1 stays dark | sun; click 1 → light; click 2 → dark |
| none | dark | works | unchanged |
| `neo-theme-neo-dark` | light | works | unchanged |

So both ACs now hold on the only path that had the bug, and the stored-theme and dark-preference paths behave as before. `getTheme()` is the right call: on the default path the viewport keeps no theme class of its own, which is what `e2e/portal/StoredThemeBoot.spec.mjs` expects.
